page.layout: Left: a framed engraving, cut off at the page edge and covering the left part of the text block. Right: a narrow column of printed line-ends, visible only where the engraving does not cover it. Below: three full-width lines of text, then the signature line with the catchword at the right.

main_text.p: [illegible, ~6 letters]vördern Finger gen Himmel ganz demütig erha-ben: Von danen auß einer liechte Wolcken etwas/den Schneflocken/oder Regentropffen fast gleich/

page.notes: The engraving covers the left part of the page, so the start of every column line is missing; only the visible line ends are transcribed, as fragments. The top-left fragment of the first full line above "vördern" is hidden. Long s is written as s throughout. The page number "71" is set in a damaged or superscript form and is uncertain. The catchword "Das" stands at the right beside the signature. No marginal notes are visible.
